name: Rudra – AI Auto Content Generator For Website
author: grprajapat

sections.description:
Rudra AI Auto Content Generator allows WordPress users to easily create and manage AI-powered content. It is designed for beginners and professionals alike.

Key Features:

  • AI Agents: Create multiple agents using ChatGPT or Google Gemini to generate content automatically.
  • Planner: Schedule articles with titles, keywords, and categories. Plan one-time or recurring content publication.
  • Autopublish: Automatically generate and publish posts directly to your site.
  • Featured Images: Assign images automatically to your posts.
  • Safe & Flexible: Works with all WordPress themes and editors.

How to Use:

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to the “Rudra AI” menu in the WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Create an Agent: Add AI agents that will generate your content.
  4. Create a Planner: Define titles, keywords, categories, and schedule.
  5. Run the Planner: The plugin will generate and publish posts automatically based on your settings.

Rudra AI is designed so that anyone can start generating AI content with minimal configuration.

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party AI services to generate content automatically.

Google Gemini API

Rudra AI can connect to the Google Gemini API to generate article content using artificial intelligence.

What the service is and what it is used for
The Google Gemini API is used to generate blog post content based on article titles and instructions defined by the site administrator.

What data is sent and when
When an article is generated, the plugin sends the article title and generation instructions to the Google Gemini API.
No personal user data or visitor data is sent.
The request is made only when an administrator runs a planner or when the scheduled cron job executes.

Service provider
Google LLC

Privacy Policy

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/rudra-ai directory, or install via the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the “Rudra AI” menu to configure agents and planners.
sections.faq:
Can I use multiple AI agents?

Yes, you can create multiple agents and assign them to different planners.

Does it support featured images?

Yes, you can automatically assign a featured image when generating posts.

Can I schedule recurring posts?

Yes, you can set the Planner to run periodically, generating posts automatically.
